data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 11.1 million in 2014. This was primarily driven by adverse development on specific accounts, including increased notifications on New Zealand earthquake claims and additional strengthening required for the UK Solicitors' Professional Indemnity account from older years of account. These adverse movements were partially offset by favourable development in the Marine, Aviation and Transport division, which contributed to a GBP 14.2 million profit on the closure of the 2012 Year of Account. The Political Risk division also saw significant loss experience.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported as a net figure (after reinsurance) in the narrative, as no gross figure was explicitly available from a movement note or claims development triangle. The GBP 14.2m profit on the 2012 YOA closure is a net figure and is a component of the overall prior year development, but the GBP 11.1m net deterioration is taken as the overall prior year movement for all prior years.
